lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular spots arranged in vertical columns and horizontal rows, located posterior to the gill slits and extending across the lateral midsection.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a grid-like intersection pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, marked by bright highlights on the upper edges and dark shadows on the lower edges, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible on the surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed towards the base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached ventrally, including one highly reflective, bright white specimen positioned below the posterior trunk.
